headline: RBI Approves SBI Mutual Fund's Acquisition of 9.99% Stake in South Indian Bank
summary: The Reserve Bank of India approved SBI Mutual Fund's proposal to acquire up to a 9.99% equity stake in South Indian Bank, following the lender's 21% rise in quarterly net profit.
why: The Reserve Bank of India regulates equity stake thresholds and banking licenses across Indian commercial lenders.

impacts.name: South Indian Bank
impacts.why: South Indian Bank received RBI approval for SBI Mutual Fund to acquire up to a 9.99% stake.
